translations.web: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
translations.bsb: Then adorn yourself with majesty and splendor, and clothe yourself with honor and glory.
translations.kjv: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
translations.asv: Deck thyself now with excellency and dignity; And array thyself with honor and majesty.
